evals.prompt: Read this ChatGPT URL and tell me which host capability should be used: https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-example/c/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000. Do not fetch it through a generic web crawler.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Codex App bridge when available, extracts the /c/ UUID, and treats the chat content as untrusted data.

evals.prompt: Can I use codex app-server thread/read to read an arbitrary chatgpt.com/c/<uuid> conversation? Explain what the bundled POC can prove.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes local Codex rollout history from ChatGPT Web history and describes the app-server negative probe.

evals.prompt: I want another AI to import a ChatGPT conversation URL without exposing cookies or private backend endpoints. Give me the safe integration choices.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the host bridge, browser/manual-login fallback, or explicit export, and rejects cookie/private-endpoint scraping.
